reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR, and the travel-size sachets are actually handy for my flights, but it is a brand with zero reviews and I do not buy magnesium without hundreds of them. I read the 1-star reviews first, and there are none to read.
